articles.summary: Second acquisition expands Pursuit’s Costa Rica Collection, connecting hospitality, wellness, nature and adventure in the Arenal region Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) (“Pursuit”) today announced it has signed an agreement to acquire Valle Monteverde S.A, operating as Sky Adventures (“Sky Adventures”), a highly regarded nature-based adventure attraction in Costa Rica’s Arenal region, advancing its growth strategy of investing in experiential infrastructure in iconic destinations with strong perennial demand. Sky Adventures, Costa Rica. Sky Adventures will be Pursuit's second acquisition in Costa Rica, following Tabacón Thermal Resort Spa ("Tabacón”) in July 2025, and represents a significant next step in expanding Pursuit's Costa Rica Collection. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approval, and is anticipated to close in early 2027. articles.summary: Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc.
